toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: Demonstration comparison for headset stand on synthetic direct channel rule as of 2026-10-24. Compared target revenue margins of 20%, 30%, and 40% with and without a 10% discount. Discounted scenarios did not retain the requested target revenue margin: realized margins fell below target in all three cases.
assumptions: Product and rule are synthetic demonstration records, not confirmed business data (status: Demonstration).
All channel charges are applied on the same revenue basis per the synthetic rule: 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, BRL 2 fixed fee.
Discount rate is 10% applied to the recommended price; tool-calculated discounted cases are shown alongside undiscounted cases.
Failure provisioning includes the product's stored 10% failure rate and assumes full-print retry cost in the deterministic calculator.
limitations: Unmodeled overhead beyond stored product costs is not included.
Failure model assumes full-print retry; actual scrap/rework behavior may differ.
No marketplace verification is available; the channel rule is synthetic and not a current Shopee fee schedule.
